skill.summary: Custom automation services using Python, APIs, and tools like Zapier to streamline tasks such as social media, email, data entry, and lead management.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release offering custom business automation services.

- Launched three service tiers: Hourly Automation, Monthly Retainer, and One-Time Project.
- Supported automation areas include social media, emails, data processing, lead management, and more.
- Services use tools such as Python, JavaScript, Zapier, Make (n8n), APIs, and browser automation.
- Contact options provided via Telegram, email, and Moltbook.
